id: \rSuzie: Have you battled my big brother yet?
en: \rSuzie: Have you battled my big brother yet?
it: \rSuzie: Hai già lottato contro il mio fratellone?

id: \rNidoran, sit.
en: \rNidoran, sit.
it: \rNidoran, seduto.

id: \bBilly: My twin's name is Tilly.
en: \bBilly: My twin's name is Tilly.
it: \bBilly: La mia gemella si chiama Tilly.

id: \rYolanda: Our brother Brock does all the cooking and cleaning around here.
en: \rYolanda: Our brother Brock does all the cooking and cleaning around here.
it: \rYolanda: Nostro fratello Brock si occupa di cucinare e pulire per tutti.

id: \rYolanda: You beat Brock?! Here, take this then.
en: \rYolanda: You beat Brock?! Here, take this then.
it: \rYolanda: Hai battuto Brock?! Allora prendi questo.

id: \rThat's Sandstorm. It inflicts damage every turn to Pokémon that are not the Rock, Ground, or Steel type.
en: \rThat's Sandstorm. It inflicts damage every turn to Pokémon that are not the Rock, Ground, or Steel type.
it: \rÈ Terrempesta. Infligge danni a ogni turno ai Pokémon che non sono di tipo Roccia, Terra o Acciaio.

id: \bNido
en: \bNido
it: \bNido

id: \rTilly: My twin's name is Billy.
en: \rTilly: My twin's name is Billy.
it: \rTilly: Il mio gemello si chiama Billy.

id: \bPokémon learn new moves as they grow.
en: \bPokémon learn new moves as they grow.
it: \bI Pokémon imparano nuove mosse man mano che crescono.

id: \bBut some moves must be taught to them by people.
en: \bBut some moves must be taught to them by people.
it: \bMa alcune mosse devono essere insegnate loro dalle persone.

id: \bTommy: We all help Brock out at the gym whenever we can.
en: \bTommy: We all help Brock out at the gym whenever we can.
it: \bTommy: Aiutiamo tutti Brock in palestra ogni volta che possiamo.

id: \bTimmy: You better not beat my big brother.
en: \bTimmy: You better not beat my big brother.
it: \bTimmy: Faresti meglio a non battere il mio fratellone.

id: \bI like having Brock and his family around. There are plenty of kids to play with.
en: \bI like having Brock and his family around. There are plenty of kids to play with.
it: \bMi piace avere Brock e la sua famiglia nei paraggi. Ci sono un sacco di bambini con cui giocare.

id: \bForrest: Oh, you plan on challenging Brock?
en: \bForrest: Oh, you plan on challenging Brock?
it: \bForrest: Oh, hai intenzione di sfidare Brock?

id: \bIf you beat him I will give you something nice.
en: \bIf you beat him I will give you something nice.
it: \bSe lo batti, ti darò qualcosa di bello.

id: \bForrest: You beat Brock?! Here, take this then.
en: \bForrest: You beat Brock?! Here, take this then.
it: \bForrest: Hai battuto Brock?! Allora prendi questo.

id: \bThat's Sandstorm. It inflicts damage every turn to Pokémon that are not the Rock, Ground, or Steel type.
en: \bThat's Sandstorm. It inflicts damage every turn to Pokémon that are not the Rock, Ground, or Steel type.
it: \bÈ Terrempesta. Infligge danni a ogni turno ai Pokémon che non sono di tipo Roccia, Terra o Acciaio.

id: \bForrest: I hope to be the Gym Leader after Brock is done.
en: \bForrest: I hope to be the Gym Leader after Brock is done.
it: \bForrest: Spero di diventare Capopalestra quando Brock avrà finito.

id: \bForrest: I'm currently in charge of the Gym. I hope I can handle it.
en: \bForrest: I'm currently in charge of the Gym. I hope I can handle it.
it: \bForrest: Al momento sono io a gestire la Palestra. Spero di esserne all'altezza.

id: \rCindy: Our parents left, so Brock takes care of us now.
en: \rCindy: Our parents left, so Brock takes care of us now.
it: \rCindy: I nostri genitori se ne sono andati, quindi ora è Brock a prendersi cura di noi.

id: \bSalvadore: Brock is more than just a Gym Leader, he is the best brother we could ever have.
en: \bSalvadore: Brock is more than just a Gym Leader, he is the best brother we could ever have.
it: \bSalvadore: Brock non è solo un Capopalestra, è il miglior fratello che potessimo desiderare.

id: \bOur Pokémon is hard to handle because we got it in a trade.
en: \bOur Pokémon is hard to handle because we got it in a trade.
it: \bIl nostro Pokémon è difficile da gestire perché l'abbiamo ottenuto con uno scambio.

id: \bIt grows fast, but it may ignore an unskilled Trainer in battle.
en: \bIt grows fast, but it may ignore an unskilled Trainer in battle.
it: \bCresce in fretta, ma in lotta può ignorare un Allenatore inesperto.

id: \bIf only we had some Badges...
en: \bIf only we had some Badges...
it: \bSe solo avessimo qualche Medaglia...
